_doc: Balance values for batting (design/game-brief.md MVP 2, story-001-swipe-swing-batting). Times are seconds, distances are CSS pixels, layout values are fractions of the canvas.

timing_windows._doc: Upper bound of |swing time - ball arrival time| for each grade, best first. Anything slower than foul is a whiff.

swipe._doc: A drag shorter than min_distance_px counts as a tap (level swing). Within level_angle_deg of horizontal is a level swing; steeper is upper (up) or down (down).

ideal_swing._doc: The swing type that best matches each pitch height.

outcomes._doc: Result for each swing type at each timing grade after the match adjustment. A grade of foul is always a foul.

layout._doc: Positions as fractions of canvas width (x) and height (y); sizes as fractions of canvas height.
